Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen  01.10.2024  SL No.22  Court No.29  (gc)
 (Allowed)
 CRM (A) 3496 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Se  Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 read with Section 482 o  Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in con  Dantan Police Station Case No.323 of 2023 dated 14.10  under Sections 498A/304B/306/34 of the Indian Penal C  And

In the matter of : Chaitanya Patra @ Chitanya Patra &
 
 Mr. Navanil De,
 Mr. Srinjan Ghosh  ....For the Petitioners.

Mr. Arindam Sen,
 Ms. Sana Naaz  ... For the State.
 1.
The petitioners are the brother-in-laws of the victim lady.
2. The learned Counsel for the State submits that the husband of the victim was arrested and presently is in custody.
The mother-in- law and the father-in-law on surrender were granted bail by the learned jurisdictional court.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the commission of the alleged offence and the allegations against the present petitioners appear to be general and omnibus in nature and they are similarly placed as that of the mother-in-law and the father-in-law who have been enlarged on bail and moreover, charge-sheet has already been filed, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners namely, Chaitanya Patra @
Chitanya Patra and Ganesh Patra, Signed By :
shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- GURUPADA CHAKRABARTY High Court of Calcutta 1 st of October 2024 06:58:08 PM each, with two registered sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.,
1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.
5.

It is also directed that the petitioners shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dantan, Paschim Midnapore in connection with G.R. Case No.871 of 2023 within 10 days from date.
